title: WKEYDAO and GOT bounded host operation proof
scope: Two independently compiled exact runtimes with separate source/state bindings; synthetic host operations only, no production candidate or new VM opcode.
source_pin: OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts@8e0296096449d9b1cd7c5631e917330635244c37: four exact shared dependencies plus GOT ECDSA/IERC20; neither custom contracts/ERC20.sol has an independent maintainer pin established
findings: WKEYDAO stores domain separator at slot 8 and combined roles at root 9; GOT computes its domain inside permit and uses roles root 8.
Both use MaxSupply slot 6 and nonce root 7; burn decreases the cap, and WKEYDAO alone exposes _burnFrom publicly.
Whole runtime and creation-object compilation and both raw metadata strings match separately without substitutions.
No source callsite changes role admins. Compiler or library similarity alone cannot qualify a runtime or candidate.
WKEYDAO constructor stops at unsupported CHAINID with exact five-store rollback; GOT original constructor returns its exact runtime with 17 stores and three role logs in synthetic state.
